entries.title: Return to service without a test
entries.lesson: If a joint is disturbed, test it before service, because untested joints leak (EVD-0001).

tier_messages.T1: Do not pressurise without the test record.

recommendations.what: Interlock pressurisation on a signed test record
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of restarts with a test record

entries.title: Display-only alarm had no shutdown
entries.lesson: If an alarm only displays, nobody is told to act on it (EVD-0002).

tier_messages.T2: Confirm each alarm has a defined response.

verification.indicator: share of alarms with a response step

recommendations.what: Add an automatic shutdown on the gas alarm
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of gas alarms with a tested shutdown
